links.outcome: Knowledge score and satisfaction, chatbot vs in-person genetic counselor pre-test counseling in randomized trial
links.effect: Median knowledge score 11 (chatbot) vs 12 (counselor), p = 0.09; median satisfaction score 30 vs 30, p = 0.19; no significant differences.
links.quote: There was no significant difference in median knowledge score between Chatbot and traditional counseling (11 vs. 12, p = 0.09) or in median patient satisfaction score (30 vs. 30, p = 0.19).

unlisted_practices: Using an AI chatbot in place of genetic counselors for pre-test counseling to expand access to genetics services

screen.reason: Prospective randomized trial comparing chatbot-based pre-test genetic counseling to traditional in-person counseling among breast cancer patients in a clinical care setting.
